questions.question: In Zechariah's vision of a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top, how many lamps were on it?
The LORD told Zerubbabel his work would be done not by might nor by power. By what would it be done?

In Zechariah's vision of the gold lampstand, what did the angel say the two olive trees and their branches were?

answers.text: Two anointed ones standing beside the Lord
Two watchmen standing on the city wall
Two guards standing at the temple gate
